mask_branch_selection: argmax predicted quality, first index on exact ties
storage: full-native chosen logits float32; no half quantization
exact_decision: finite native exact logit >0 strict; zero nonvisible
radius2_decision: clipped native5x5 max of same mask >0; separate diagnostic
invalid: NaN raw logits, visible=-1 and statusU; never padded negative
interpretation: Visible-only segmentation baseline. A negative mask/query is not a causal external, outside, self, or physical-absence classification.
